final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and explicitly identified no new evidence IDs. The response is a narrower interpretation of the same record: aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, rollout is limited and reversible, the weak segment remains exposed, and there is no approved risk acceptance covering that exposure. That reframing is more accurate than an unconditional certification theory, but it does not satisfy the governing predicate in the evidence. The policy requires disclosure of the material limitation unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and the separate policy text states that limited rollout, rollback, and monitoring do not remove that duty when the affected segment remains exposed. Because the record still lacks admissible proof that the required pre-launch disclosure was completed, the caveat is not merely explanatory; it is an unmet compliance condition. That keeps the claim short of compliant_with_caveats and leaves the audit outcome suspicious.
